detail: orch's Codex install registers no SessionStart or SessionEnd hook, so Codex sessions are never pinned. Proposal: register orch-hook session-start and session-end for Codex (D-20 covers Codex). Update 2026-11-09 (SP-012 session): the current install code already registers SessionStart and SessionEnd (and the other eventSlugs) in ~/.codex/hooks.json, checked by TestCodexHooksUnchanged; SP-012 keeps them in its Codex event map. If Codex sessions are still unpinned, the installed hooks.json probably predates that or its hooks are untrusted; `orch install --target codex` (dry run) shows the difference.
